description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kohilawewa, Wariyapola, D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420903
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including details about land ownership, property boundaries, encumbrances, and legal status of various land plots. The content focuses on land registration and property rights rather than government personnel changes, organizational structures, or other specialized categories.
